title: NumericalPDE PorousMediumTravelingWave

stats.done_summary: Successfully implemented adaptive-step numerical integration of porous medium traveling wave ODE using SciPy's solve_ivp with DOP853 method (rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-10). Derived exact solution f(ξ) = [c(m-1)/m (ξ* - ξ)]^{1/(m-1)} for ξ < ξ*, f(ξ)=0 otherwise. Validated numerical implementation against exact solution with machine precision. Generated comprehensive report with methodology, results, figures, and analysis of parameter dependence (m > 1 controls front shape, c > 0 scales solution). All deliverables complete: code in code/, outputs in outputs/, report in report/report.md with figures in report/images/.
